instructions_zh: 第1—4题，请想一想过去一个月里通常一晚的睡眠情况。第5—7题，请回想过去一个月睡眠不好对你的影响。最后一题询问睡眠问题持续了多久。

items.en: … how long does it take you to fall asleep?
items.zh: 你需要多长时间才能入睡？
items.stem_en: Thinking about a typical night in the last month …

items.en: … if you then wake up during the night … how long are you awake for in total? (add all the wakenings up)
items.zh: 如果你在夜里醒来，醒着的时间加起来一共有多长？（把各次醒着的时间相加）
items.stem_en: Thinking about a typical night in the last month …

items.en: … how many nights a week do you have a problem with your sleep?
items.zh: 你每周有几个晚上遇到睡眠问题？
items.stem_en: Thinking about a typical night in the last month …

items.en: … how would you rate your sleep quality?
items.zh: 你觉得自己的睡眠质量怎么样？
items.stem_en: Thinking about a typical night in the last month …

items.en: … affected your mood, energy, or relationships?
items.zh: 睡眠不好在多大程度上影响了你的心情、精力或人际关系？
items.stem_en: Thinking about the past month, to what extent has poor sleep …

items.en: … affected your concentration, productivity, or ability to stay awake
items.zh: 睡眠不好在多大程度上影响了你集中注意、做事的效率或保持清醒的能力？
items.stem_en: Thinking about the past month, to what extent has poor sleep …

items.zh: 总的来说，睡眠不好给你带来了多大困扰？
items.stem_en: Thinking about the past month, to what extent has poor sleep …

items.en: … how long have you had a problem with your sleep?
items.zh: 你的睡眠问题持续多久了？

options.en: I don’t have a problem/<1 mo
options.zh: 没有睡眠问题，或不足1个月

scoring.optional_rescale: total / 3.2 gives 0–10; keep out of main lay report to avoid redundant score jargon
scoring.missing: Original appendix does not specify imputation. Project conservative rule: any missing item => no total/band; invite completion; never zero-fill.

parameters.population: 2014 adult development study total n=30941 (71% female), mainly self-selected online adults; threshold evaluated in Science Centre sample against ISI classification (n=255 usable, 27 ISI>=15,228 ISI<15)
parameters.comparison: SCI<=16 identified 89% of ISI>=15 group; >16 identified82% of ISI<15 group. Not evaluated against independent clinical diagnosis in this paper.
parameters.not_applicable_as: Chinese validated cutoff, child/adolescent cutoff, diagnosis, prevalence estimate
parameters.source: 2014 paper page3 concurrent validity; page4 limitations

follow_up.title: 睡眠可能正在拖累你的日常
follow_up.body: 你的回答提示，睡眠困扰值得进一步留意。与其责怪自己“怎么还睡不好”，不如先看看：难的是入睡、夜里醒来，还是白天受影响？这些线索可以帮助你更具体地描述自己的处境。
follow_up.next_step: 可以先记录几天的睡眠和白天感受；如果困扰持续，或明显影响学习、工作和安全，建议与专业人员讨论。这个结果本身不能确定你是否有失眠障碍。

not_flagged.title: 这次回答没有触及原研究的睡眠提醒线
not_flagged.body: 这次回答没有达到原研究用于提醒进一步了解的界线，但这并不意味着每一晚都该睡得完美。你仍可以留意让你感觉最不舒服的那一项。
not_flagged.next_step: 保留对自己有帮助的规律；如果你依然感觉很困扰，不必等到得分“够高或够低”才寻求帮助。

incomplete.title: 还差一点信息
incomplete.body: 有题目没有填写，因此暂不计算总结果。你可以补充，也可以选择不继续。
